mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.target_id, c.target_type, c.user_id, c.content, c.like_count, c.reply_count, c.is_top, c.root_id, c.parent_id, c.parent_user_id, c.avatar_url, c.status, c.created_date, u.name AS user_name, pu.name AS parent_user_name FROM comments c LEFT JOIN `user` u ON c.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN `user` pu ON c.parent_user_id = pu.user_id WHERE c.target_id = #{targetId} AND c.target_type = #{targetType} AND c.status = 1 AND c.root_id = 0 ORDER BY c.is_top DESC, c.created_date DESC

SELECT c.id, c.target_id, c.target_type, c.user_id, c.content, c.parent_id, c.parent_user_id, c.root_id, c.like_count, c.reply_count, c.avatar_url, c.status, c.created_date, u.name AS user_name, pu.name AS parent_user_name FROM comments c LEFT JOIN `user` u ON c.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN `user` pu ON c.parent_user_id = pu.user_id WHERE c.root_id = #{rootId} AND c.status = 1 ORDER BY c.created_date ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments ( target_id, target_type, user_id, content, root_id, parent_id, parent_user_id, avatar_url, created_date, updated_date ) VALUES ( #{targetId}, #{targetType}, #{userId}, #{content}, #{rootId}, #{parentId}, #{parentUserId}, #{avatarUrl}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE comments SET reply_count = #{count}, updated_date = NOW() WHERE id = #{commentId}
UPDATE comments SET like_count = #{count}, updated_date = NOW() WHERE id = #{commentId}
UPDATE comments SET status = #{status}, updated_date = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
